source_lifecycle.finding: archive() computes the existing raw size/SHA, emits NORMAL_READY, then requires exactly matching JSON on the original stdin. Only after that ACK and a repeated file check does it unlink the raw and write NORMAL_LOCAL_SIZE_SHA_VERIFIED_REMOTE_CLEARED. No lost-owner recovery endpoint exists in this handshake.

The four train workers first wait for their own training process, validate COMPLETE/full50, and run the CPU audit. They then submit archive work to a separate single-worker executor and return. The parent obtains all train futures before reading archive future results. An exception stored by an archive future does not itself cancel the other train futures.

If the lost SSH stream yields EOF, json.loads('') fails before unlink. If emitting to the lost stream raises BrokenPipeError, it fails earlier. If stdin remains open without an ACK, the archive worker can remain blocked and later archive tasks queue behind it. These are source-derived possible outcomes of this actual lost owner, not claims about the current remote process.

An archive exception propagates when its future.result() is read after train futures complete; a blocked archive also prevents normal finalization. controller_result.json and CONTROLLER_COMPLETE are written only after every archive future succeeds. Thus four genuine completed trainings can coexist with missing controller_result and no successful original transport closure.

Training stdout/stderr goes to each run log, and each child starts its own session. The wrapper waits and writes the actual child exit receipt. Its finally block can kill a still-live child if that execute call unwinds. Do not stop or disturb the controller while any original training/audit worker remains active; source separation is not a guarantee against unrelated external termination.

The trainer updates best.pth only on strictly higher benchmark mAP, then after all 50 epochs strictly reloads that best, evaluates to best_per_query and best_official_arrays.npz, and only then writes COMPLETE result.json. Copy final best/raw after true completion; an intermediate best file is not a completed-run receipt.

Separate archive futures permit already admitted original full50 workers to finish without requiring each preceding archive ACK; an ACK exception alone is not a reason to restart training.
